title: Diverse Evidence, Better Forecasts: Multi-Agent Deliberation Under Information Asymmetry
locator: Implementation (same-model copies); Table 2 public-ratio ablation; §5.4 / Figure 4; Limitations / Proposition 3.1 assumptions
excerpt: All experiments use gpt-5.4-mini via OpenRouter as the primary model. J=3 agents, R=2 rounds, ρ=0.5 default. Table 2 PolyGym N=375: InfoDelphi Brier 0.178 Acc 77.9%; ρ=1.0 (all public) Brier 0.193 Acc 75.7%; Standard Debate Brier 0.202 Acc 73.9%; Chain-of-Thought Brier 0.216 Acc 69.9%. Inter-agent variance is 1.7× higher under information asymmetry than homogeneous input. Figure 4: under All Info (ρ=1.0) and Random Split, deliberation reduces variance by 90–92%; under relevance-based routing (ρ=0.5) variance reduction is 73%. Proposition 3.1 assumes Cov(εi_priv, εj_priv)=0. Limitations: documents retrieved for the same question share topical correlations, partially violating the independence assumptions.
